title: Ad Orientem Sacred Places — Claude completed research row
contract: Research output. No edits to production registry; preserve original candidate_id and country.

row_shape.display_name: preferred official local language or established name
row_shape.place_address: street or site address when provided; do not invent
row_shape.google_maps_url: optional Google Maps search link using grounded site coordinates or official address
row_shape.osm_url: exact OpenStreetMap object URL or null
row_shape.rite: Latin / Byzantine / Maronite / Chaldean / other attested / unknown
row_shape.custodian: named order/parish/diocese if sourced, otherwise null
distinct_from: candidate or canonical IDs for different nearby features
row_shape.proposed_new_place_id: proposal only for genuinely new distinct physical site
inferred_fields: names of any values reasoned from institution/feature rather than explicitly sourced
row_shape.evidence_summary: concise site-specific source and scope decision
remaining_unknowns: explicit residual gaps; no artificial empty records
row_shape.photo_fields: DO NOT RESEARCH, DOWNLOAD, POPULATE OR RECOMMEND IMAGES

deliverables.completed_candidates.csv: One row for every one of the original 750 candidate IDs; preserve frozen IDs; columns include original + new research fields.
deliverables.completed_candidates.jsonl: 750 full records using schema, structured source refs and confidence at field level.
deliverables.new_sites.jsonl: Additional distinct sites discovered from Catholic sources, with stable proposed NEW IDs and nonduplication checks; distinct from original 750.
deliverables.source_evidence.csv: Candidate/field/claim/source URL/publisher/observed tag/evidence tier/confidence for audit.
deliverables.canonical_reuse_crosswalk.csv: Candidate ID -> existing canonical Place ID; never add as new physical site.
deliverables.geography_exceptions.csv: All 35 mapped historical exceptions carried forward with determinations and remaining holds.
deliverables.field_coverage.json: Denominators and completed vs inferred vs unknown per column; never treat inferred as verified.
deliverables.unresolved_exceptions.csv: Only genuinely irresolvable or inconsistent records with explicit next query.
deliverables.summary.md: Results and exact status; no marketing claims or fabricated release totals.
